review_type: Independent static critique of proposed strategy; not empirical validation

roles.scope: Official metric, exposure, temporal identifiability, private selection; final plan critique
Training/source recipe, target construction, HPO, scheduling, serving; width correction
arXiv queries and primary sources; independent proposals committed before history crosswalk

material_corrections_applied: H390 is a recipe ID; all C recurrent members have hidden width 256, so its runtime does not prove width-384 feasibility.
A learned clock must change decay/window membership/time channels; pure monotone time reparameterization cannot change spatial path areas.
Project numerator and denominator moments separately; do not average ratios or double-apply outcome weights to moment projection.
Temporal purging requires a supported target-overlap bound; unknown horizons cannot be replaced by the disputed four-event law.
Additional training data must be explicitly authorized for participants.
Doubled-row timing is a hypothetical sensitivity analysis under an applicable whole-test cap, not a forecast.
root_disposition: Proposal complete with corrections; no new scientific evidence, score forecast or experimental admission.
limitations: All reviewers share one model family
Source text and recorded scores were inspected; predictions were not recomputed
Private volume, final-selection slots and current rule updates require official confirmation before release
